Subject: Next steps & MAP draft for MedNexus procurement - decision criteria & evidence asks

Rajiv — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Decision makers / roles (from call)
- You: economic buyer & product sponsor (confirmed)
- Anita Shah (CFO): final budget approver / legal signals with procurement
- Chris Longford (Procurement): purchasing / POs
- Legal (TBD): contract redlines

2) Decision criteria you highlighted
- End-to-end data security (SOC 2, encryption at rest/in transit)
- Predictable latency and SLOs for our 99th percentile requests
- Cost per 1k tokens at pilot scale and at steady state
- Ability to run in your VPC / keep telemetry off by default

3) Proposed MAP (draft attached) — high level milestones
- Week 1 (this week): Confirm stakeholders + evidence needs (owner: Rajiv)
- Week 2: Security evidence review (SOC2 report + config checklist) (owner: Anita/Legal)
- Week 3-4: Pilot SOW + infrastructure prep (owner: Redwood CS / MedNexus eng)
- Week 6: Pilot kickoff
- Week 10: Business review / go/no-go decision

Attachments: I attached a one-page MAP (MedNexus_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short security-evidence checklist (security-evidence-checklist.pdf) to speed review. I also created a shared doc with editable milestones: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBz-MedNexus-MAP-draft

Asks from your side: 
- Can you confirm the primary legal contact and procurement timelines (target PO date)?
- Any specific data residency / vendor terms that are deal stoppers?
- Would your security/legal prefer a short tech review call next week or just the checklist?

Proposed next meeting windows: Tue 06/23 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 06/24 14:00–15:00 PT. Happy to adjust.

Thanks — I think we have a clear path. I’ll incorporate any feedback into the MAP and re-share.

Best,

--

Thanks Aditya — good summary. A few clarifications from this side: 

- Confirming roles: I am the product sponsor and will own the pilot. Anita (CFO) is the budget approver; she’ll need SOC2 + encryption details before she signs off.
- Procurement: Chris runs purchasing; target for PO is by end of July if legal review goes smoothly. Chris looped here.
- Legal: primary legal reviewer will be Anita's team; I can introduce you to their lead if helpful.

Quick Qs: 
1) On PII handling — can Redwood provide a short bullet list of what is stored in the service vs what stays in our VPC?
2) For SOC2 evidence — do you have a redacted report and a short runbook for incident response we can share with Anita?

I like the MAP timeline. Please add the following decision criteria explicitly: cost forecast at 3-month pilot scale, and rollback plan if pilot doesn't meet latency SLOs.

I can do Tue 06/23 10:00–10:30 PT for a quick security sync; if you prefer the longer slot we can do that too.

—Rajiv

Hi all — looping to capture the internal owners and tighten milestone dates. I've edited the shared MAP doc and pasted the table below for quick reference: 

Milestone | Owner | Target date | Deliverable
--- | --- | --- | ---
Confirm stakeholders + evidence list | Rajiv | 2026-06-25 | Email with names + evidence asks
Security evidence review (SOC2 + runbook) | Anita / Legal | 2026-07-02 | Redacted SOC2 + incident response runbook
Contract & commercial terms (SLA, pricing) | Karthik / Aditya | 2026-07-09 | Term sheet + draft SOW
Procurement / PO issuance | Chris | 2026-07-30 | Signed PO

Notes / clarifications: 
- Decision criteria (explicit): cost per 1k tokens at pilot scale, 99th-pctl latency <= 450ms for target flows, SOC2 type II or equivalent, data residency in us-east-1 by default.
- Evidence we will provide: redacted SOC2 report, encryption-at-rest statement, sample runbook for incident response, architecture diagram showing KV cache behavior and telemetry knobs.
- Action: Rajiv, if you confirm Anita + legal lead, we'll upload the redacted SOC2 and a short runbook by EOD Mon (06/22).

Related links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBz-MedNexus-MAP-draft (MAP v1)
